verdict.rationale: Porting out is a fair question for a business phone platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers porting a number into Quo ('new or ported phone number') and a cancel-anytime trial. Nothing documents port-out, the absence of lock-in fees, or where to find the account number or port-out PIN in the app.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
